text:
Ellen (Finance): quick heads-up 1 INV-2026-0450 for TidalWave ($31,250) - card charge returned do_not_honor this morning, now past due.
TidalWave Billing Bot: Reminder sent to billing@tidalwave-tech.com for INV-2026-0450 (due 2026-05-02).
Marco (AM): Priya said they expected a reseller discount to be applied; they claim our invoice shows full list price. wants to avoid escalation.
Priya (TidalWave Finance): correct - reseller partner provided a 15% pass-through discount. AP won't pay the full amount. we can pay 20% today and settle the rest after you adjust the invoice. no late fees requested.
Oscar (Collections Lead): our standard exception needs 25% upfront for reissue/adjustment, but given reseller proof we can accept 20% if they provide partner confirmation and a written acceptance. we can waive one late fee as goodwill.
Lena (Legal): email acceptance is sufficient for <$50k. please include the sentence exactly: "This agreement applies only to INV-2026-0450 and does not waive Redwood Inference's rights under any other agreement." Use verbatim.
Sam (Support): FYI they also raised a metering issue - reseller tag caused duplicate attributions. engineering found 12 duplicate requests; tentative credit ~$180. attaching reconcile.
Ellen (Finance): numbers after credit: 31,250 less 15% reseller = 26,562.50. minus $180 credit = 26,382.50 total outstanding. 20% upfront = $5,276.50. please confirm amounts in the email.
Priya (TidalWave Finance): will initiate ACH for $5,276.50 today and attach the partner discount confirmation PDF. I'll reply here with bank ref when posted.
TidalWave Billing Bot: Payment received notification: ACH pending (awaiting bank settlement).
Oscar (Collections Lead): holding escalation. if payment doesn't settle by 1789080000 we'll reopen dunning and escalate to Legal + AM.
Marco (AM): drafting confirmation snippet: ```Hi AP team - we can accept 20% today ($5,276.50) and will reissue an adjusted invoice reflecting the 15% reseller discount and $180 credit. Please reply: "I accept" and attach partner confirmation and ACH reference when available. Upon receipt of the first payment we will suspend dunning and waive one late fee.```
Priya (TidalWave Finance): reply: "I accept. ACH initiated, attaching partner confirmation." attaching partner-email.pdf
TidalWave Billing Bot: ACH authorization logged; settlement in progress.
Ellen (Finance): marking invoice as PENDING_ADJUSTED in billing dashboard and tagging WAIVED_ONE_LATE_FEE_PENDING.
Lena (Legal): uploaded the exact one-line sentence to thread; please use it unchanged in the outgoing email.
Oscar (Collections Lead): once settlement clears, we will reissue adjusted invoice and close collection case.
Marco (AM): thanks all 44d will monitor the reconciliation and confirm when final invoice issued.
Priya (TidalWave Finance): bank ref posted: TRACE-0x7b3a. will paste settlement confirm when bank finalizes.
TidalWave Billing Bot: Settlement confirmed - payment posted. Adjusted invoice reissued as INV-2026-0450-ADJ.
Ellen (Finance): applied $180 credit, recorded WAIVED_ONE_LATE_FEE, marking resolved pending customer settlement of remainder. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
